feature_history: same season for teams and relief; prior 365 days for starter and batter; strictly earlier calendar dates; all same-day updates deferred
brier_definition: sum over classes of squared probability error, no 1/2 or class-count scaling
selection_policy: No winning-feature combination or threshold retuning in this run. All additions reported on the same eligible games. Historical seasons already inspected are diagnostic, not fresh prospective OOS. No production promotion.
limitations: Actual target starter identity is a retrospective proxy for the pre-announced starter; announcement timestamps unavailable.
Lineup is first nine distinct PBP batters; not timestamped pregame announcement and cannot qualify as prospective evidence.
Late target is final score minus F5, including played extra innings. Independent nonnegative phase counts are a research approximation, not an exact inning/extra-inning/walkoff simulator.
Fixed research totals F5 4.5 and Full 8.5; not observed historical betting lines. No ROI, EV or CLV claims.
Bootstrap conditions on fitted forecasts and does not include the whole model-development uncertainty. Multiple-comparison correction supplied for primary losses only.
Existing v0.9 recovered candidate and BP30 prospective gate remain unchanged.
